caution_findings.finding: Nine DRAMP activity rows link this DOI/PMID and source-supported probe constructs, but the primary XML/PDF/supplement evidence does not report antimicrobial or anticancer assay values; the rows remain source_conflict rather than source_verified.
Nine linked experiment snapshot rows have database activity text but no assay, measure value, unit, or target organism; they are preserved as database_only_no_primary_source.

Final activity evidence contains only source-supported live-cell probe uptake/labeling/imaging performance rows. No MIC, MBC, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, antimicrobial, or anticancer primary assay value was recovered or invented.

The recovered supplementary PDF/text contains HPLC/ESI and imaging figure support, plus movies in the OA package; no structured supplementary antimicrobial/activity table was present, and HTML landing .bin files were not treated as data tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.mechanism_ontology: Worker-6 final mechanism review restricts claims to CPP-mediated cell entry, F-actin labeling, and lysosome labeling. It does not promote imaging probe evidence to an AMP antimicrobial mechanism.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: The previous ticket is closed because the missing source review was completed, supported rows were added, database conflicts were preserved, and no open blocking/major QC issue remains.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework closed the prior Batch 4 ticket for this paper. The paper is acceptable only with explicit cautions: it supports cell-penetrating fluorescent probe identity and live-cell imaging function, while linked DRAMP antimicrobial/anticancer activity annotations remain database/source conflicts rather than primary-source assay claims.
